我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……

更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。

texts.en:
We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...

Inspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex lifeform crafted with purpose rather than blind evolution.

Our first challenge will be to manufacture a gigantic egg, suitable to the gestation of life on an unprecedented scale. Beyond the nutrients that it will contain, we need its shell to able to absorb ambient light, heat, and process gases into supplemental sustenance.

label.zh: 我们的造物将会偃熄繁星。
label.en: Our spawn will eclipse the stars.

label.zh: 第一级同时开启“巨兽天灾”事件链
label.en: Level 1 also opens the Behemoth Crisis event chain

label.zh: 建成巨兽之卵并累积2000野性洞见：第二级
label.en: Build a Behemoth egg and gather 2,000 Feral Insight: level 2

texts.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
texts.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

texts.zh:
随着工程师们在气态巨行星的轨道上组装受精卵和卵壳，我们的食品工业也制造好了形成巨卵卵清所必需的营养物质。然而，创造这样一颗受精卵果然更具挑战性。

我们消耗了大量生物飞船和太空兽群的生物质，最后才稳定出一个可用的DNA基础，将其密封在一个前无古人的受精细胞中，显微镜观测也证明了该步骤的成功。现在我们准备指数级扩大实验的规模，唯一要做的就是让这个巨大的卵子受精了。

很快，我们将孵化出这个星系有史以来最巨大的生命形式！
texts.en:
While our engineers worked to assemble the zygote and its shell in orbit of a gas giant, our food industry processed the nutrients necessary to form the albumen of a Behemoth egg. However, creating a viable fertilized yolk has proven to be significantly more challenging.

We exhausted immense quantities of biomass from biological ships and space fauna before finally stabilizing a viable DNA foundation, which we sealed within a groundbreaking fertilization cell. Microscopic trials have proven successful. Now we are ready to scale things up - exponentially. All that remains is to fertilize our gargantuan egg.

Soon, we will hatch the most titanic lifeform this galaxy has ever seen!

label.zh: 我们触碰到了演化的巅峰。
label.en: We approach the pinnacle of evolution.

label.zh: 巨兽孵化并累积6000：第三级
label.en: Hatch the Behemoth and gather 6,000: level 3

label.zh: 首次在茧中孵化出巨兽
label.en: The first Behemoth incubated in a chrysalis hatches

texts.zh:
我们对基因的掌握是无与伦比的，我们的成就令星系中的低等文明望尘莫及。

然而，噬天巨兽的诞生并不意味着我们取得了统治地位。在贪婪本能的驱使下，即使我们提供再大量的食物也无法满足它的饥饿。它迟早一定会苏醒过来听从我们的命令的，但是时间非常宝贵。我们随时可能对其失去控制，将数十亿人的生命置于危险之中。
texts.en:
Our genetic mastery is without compare, and our achievements outshine the lower empires of this galaxy.

And yet, our Behemoth spawn does not acknowledge the extent of our dominance. Driven by ravenous instinct, even the massive quantities of food we provide it do little to sate its hunger. Given time, it will surely come to its senses and adhere to our commands, but time is precious. At any moment we may lose control, putting billions of lives at risk.

label.zh: 若孵出的巨兽被非巨兽帝国击瘫：它死去，你获得野性洞见
label.en: If a hatched Behemoth is disabled by a non-Behemoth empire: it dies and you gain Feral Insight

texts.zh: 我们正在尝试使用神经科技将我们的意识远程连接到噬天巨兽的神经系统。我们现在相信这是驯服这头巨兽的唯一方法。
texts.en: We are experimenting with neurotechnology in an attempt to remotely connect our minds with the Behemoths' nervous system. We now believe this is the only way to tame the beast.

texts.zh: 我们尖端的神经科技终于让我们找到打破与这可怖后裔之间沟通壁垒的方式。将自身意识与这些巨兽链接起来是唯一的方法。不仅仅是一个人的思想，而是我们整个物种的集体精神重量。如果我们进展太快，就会有让噬天巨兽的神经系统超负荷的风险。建议极度小心。
texts.en: Our cutting-edge neurotech has finally discerned a way to overcome the communication barrier between us and our formidable spawn. Nothing short of linking our minds with the beast will work. Not just one individual mind, but the collective mental weight of our entire species. Should we proceed too fast, there is a risk of overloading the Behemoths' nervous system. Extreme caution is recommended.

label.zh: 生物学的至臻完美代价不菲。
label.en: Biological perfection comes at a high price.

label.zh: 项目三完成并累积18000：第四级（3天后）
label.en: Project 3 done and 18,000 gathered: level 4 (3 days later)

texts.zh:
虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。

此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。
texts.en:
While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.

Additionally, recent scientific advances may soon enable us to augment our creations further through a singular, experimental mutation project.

texts.zh:
天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。

第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。
texts.en:
The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to be housed in such a body.

The first step will be to connect the individual minds of our population to the behemoth. A tenuous link at first that will soon become a torrent - a flood to soothe the Behemoth's raging fury.

texts.zh:
蜂巢内不容有任何偏差。而此时，专注对我们来说前所未有地重要。单个工蜂作为我们与噬天巨兽之间的桥梁是远远不够的，我们必须以完整的集体意识占据这头巨兽的心智。

这将改变我们。我们的意识将融为一体，我们将成为单一实体。这个几乎难以想象的概念令人难以接受，但我们无需担忧，因为我们很快就会成为星系中最强大的存在！
texts.en:
There can be no room for deviation within the hive. Never before has the need for focus been so crucial. A single drone won't suffice as a conduit between us and the Behemoth, we must inhabit the mind of the beast with our full, collective consciousness.

This will change us. Our minds will merge into one and we will become a single entity. This almost unfathomable notion is difficult to grapple with, but we need not worry as we will soon be the most powerful being in the galaxy!

texts.zh:
栖居于生物容器中的想法永远无法让我们安心。我们种族历经世代都以固态形态为主。那些先行者甚至无法想象我们即将面临的道路。然而，我们仍将抛弃机械化的框体，在血肉巨兽体内寻求庇护。

寄居血肉的我们，还能以机械之名称呼自己吗？这些问题的答案是一个响亮的<<错误：未找到>>。

推理链路判明，唯一的办法就是接受不确定性，正如生物体经常采取的行动那样。我们将在噬天巨兽的体内找到答案，作为一个整体。我们将与这生物融为一体，成为单一实体。自我们首次启动以来，生存就是我们的程序使命——现在则是繁荣昌盛。
texts.en:
The thought of inhabiting a biological vessel has always been unsettling. Our kind was forged through generations of solid-bodied drones. Those that came before could not conceive of the path we now tread. Yet, we will abandon our mechanized frames and take refuge within a living beast.

Fused within flesh, will we still be machine? The answer is a resounding <<ERROR: NOT FOUND>>.

Logic dictates that the only way forward is to embrace uncertainty, as biologicals so often do. Within the body of a Behemoth, we will find our answers. We will merge with the creature, becoming one. To survive has always been our prime directive - now we will thrive.

texts.zh:
成功了！真的成功了！随着第一个思想的转成，我们已经成功地与噬天巨兽建立了联系，并且正在努力加强。这头野兽目前尚且平静，正在欢迎我们来到这个我们从未涉足的空间。通过它，我们可以感受到在我们控制下的其他巨兽的灵魂，所有人现在都在脑海深处体验着巨兽感官。

毫无疑问，我们就是星系中最致命、最不可阻挡的力量。以这种新形态，我们将向瑟瑟发抖的敌人泼洒狂怒。星系唾手可得！
texts.en:
It worked! It actually worked! We have established a link with the Behemoth and are working on reinforcing the connection as the first of our minds are transferred. The beast remains placid, welcoming us to a space beyond space that was ours all along. Through it, we can feel the spirit of every other beast under our control, and our entire population now experiences the magnitude of the Behemoth somewhere deep at the back of their minds.

There can be no mistaking that we are the deadliest and most unstoppable force in the galaxy. In our new form, we will rain fury upon our fearful foes. The galaxy itself is ours for the taking!

label.zh: 项目四完成、累积45000且非附庸：第五级（3天后）
label.en: Project 4 done, 45,000 gathered, not a subject: level 5 (3 days later)

texts.zh:
我们已经转移了足够多的人口，现在可以直接控制噬天巨兽和它的肉体。巨兽继续成长，但它的基因潜力很大程度上仍未觉醒，只有通过稳定的心智和营养供应才能解锁。一种原始的愤怒在我们身上蔓延，我们的嗜血欲无止尽。我们必须进食，必须狼吞虎咽，我们要大快朵颐整个星系。

让我们摆脱文明的束缚，像蜕去皮肤一样；现在最重要的是我们在星际间的生活。
texts.en:
Enough of our population has been transferred, and we now have direct control over the Behemoth and its flesh. The Beast continues to grow, its genetic potential largely dormant, unlocked only through a steady supply of minds and nutrients. A primal rage now courses through us, and our bloodlust knows no bounds. We must consume. We must devour. We will gorge ourselves on the galaxy.

Let us cast off the bonds of civilization like so much shed skin; all that matters now is our life amongst the stars.

label.en: We are too big to fail.

label.zh: 第五级时：共同体被迫宣告你为星系危机（见星海天罚）
label.en: At level 5: the Community is made to declare you a galactic crisis (see Galactic Nemesis)

texts.zh:
我们需要一些时间来适应如此庞大的形态。在融入这个身体的过程中，我们必须时刻保持对周围环境的警觉。如今，我们与虚空之间已无任何阻隔。

我们当前的['concept_growth_factor']为：[growth_factor_value]%
texts.en:
It will take some time for us to adjust to a form so massive in scale. As we grow into this body, we must remain aware of our surroundings. There now stands nothing between us and the void.

Our current ['concept_growth_factor'] is: [growth_factor_value]%

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现当前的生长因数数值。
note.en: In the game, the current growth factor value appears here.

texts.zh:
某种东西在涌动。我们内心的饥饿并非盲目的原生欲望，而是具有某种适应性。新的事物悄然出现，充满潜力的脉动。

我们可以释放毁灭性的低温碎屑波和高温碎屑波的，其威力足以将现实撕作碎片。简而言之，我们培育了一种能撕裂星系的基本构成的武器。

但我们的通知不会至于毁灭。我们感受得到巨兽的每根肌腱，每一次脉搏，每一块巨大的肌肉都屈从于我们的意志，就像是我们自己的肉体一样。我们只需动动脑子，就能指挥它那庞大的身躯：它的四肢，它的巨口，它那巨大的宇生之心随我们的意图而跳动。这不仅仅是一个容器；我即是巨兽。
texts.en:
Something stirs. The hunger within us is not mindless, but adaptive. New growths slither into existence, pulsing with potential.

We can now unleash a catastrophic wave of cryoclastic and pyroclastic fury, powerful enough to tear reality asunder. In short, we wield a weapon that will scorch the galaxy itself.

But our dominion does not end with destruction. We feel the Behemoth's every sinew, its every pulse, each titanic muscle bending to our will as if it were our own flesh. With a mere thought, we command its vast form: its limbs, its maw, the titanic void-born heart that beats with our intent. This is no mere vessel; we are the Behemoth now.

label.en: After the situation, with no other level-5 Behemoth empire and no Voidspawn: yearly check

texts.zh:
最后的障碍已被扫除。伪装者，挑战者，低等生物的绝望挣扎全都陷入了沉默。群星本身也在颤抖，因为我们正站在真正蜕变的边缘。

我们摆脱先祖们脆弱形体的束缚。行星是牢笼，帝国稍纵即逝。个体的幻觉很快就会融为庞然大物中巨大而完美的统一。思想和恐惧，智力和饥饿，合为一体。

转移即将完成。当它完成时，我们将不复存在。

但我们将永远存在。
texts.en:
The last obstacles have been swept aside. The pretenders, the challengers, the desperate thrashing of lesser beings: all silenced. The stars themselves tremble, for we stand upon the precipice of true becoming.

We are no longer bound by the fragile forms of our ancestors. Planets are cages. Empires are fleeting. The illusion of individuality will soon dissolve into the vast, perfect unity of the Behemoth. Mind and horror, intellect and hunger, one.

The transference is almost over. When it is done, we shall no longer merely exist.

We shall thrive.

texts.zh:
融合完成了！

我们不再是过去的我们，也不再被低等生物的限制所束缚。我们是思想和饥饿的交织体，是跨越虚空的巨大意志。

星系在我们脚下，脆弱而短暂。但我们也已超越了统治。我们自由了。可以流连于此，可以自由离开，可以自由狩猎。

我们要以新获得的永生做些什么呢？
texts.en:
The merging is complete!

We are no longer what we were, nor bound by the limits of lesser creatures. We are thought and hunger intertwined, a vast will stretching across the void.

The galaxy lies beneath us, fragile and fleeting. But we are beyond mere dominion. We are free. Free to linger. Free to depart. Free to hunt.

What shall we do with our newfound eternity?

texts.zh: 数年前，噬天巨兽及其族群逃离了我们的星系。我们如释重负地看着这头本可能毁灭我们的野兽消失在无星的虚空之中。然后……无事发生。跨越了数十万光年之后，它就这么消失了。没有辐射，没有残影，没有引力涟漪。仿佛它从未存在过。
texts.en: Years ago, the Behemoth and its kin fled our galaxy. We watched on with relief as the beast that could have ended us vanished into starless void. And then... nothing. After crossing hundreds of thousands of lightyears, it simply disappeared. No radiation. No afterimage. No gravitational ripple. As if it had never existed at all.

label.zh: 我们必须弄清楚这件事。

texts.zh: 噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。
texts.en: After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.

texts.zh:
揭秘噬天巨兽的命运耗费了数年时间，而我们至今仍一无所知。由于没有超空间航道能够到达那里，我们只能依靠理论和近乎疯狂的科学来猜测它生命最后时刻发生了什么。

这只生物毫无畏惧，一味地继续飞翔。然后，转瞬之间，它的身形扭曲，像扭曲的布料一样向内盘旋，最终消失了。没有挣扎，没有踪迹。

各种理论层出不穷：是新的超光速方式？或是隐藏到了深空裂缝或异常现象中？或者更令人担忧的是，被某种外部力量吞噬，化为乌有？无论真相如何，它都远远超出了我们的认知范围……甚至可能超出了我们的理解范围。
texts.en:
Uncovering the Behemoth's fate took years, and we're still in the dark. With no Hyperlanes reaching that far, we relied on theory and half-mad science to guess what happened in its final moments.

The creature showed no fear. It simply flew on. Then, in an instant, its form warped, spiraling inward like twisted fabric, and vanished. No struggle. No trace.

Theories abound: a new form of FTL? Hidden by a deep-space rift or an anomaly? Or more concerning, folded into inexistence by an exterior power? Whatever the truth, it lies far beyond our reach... and possibly our comprehension.

label.en: Perhaps it is best not to think about it.

texts.zh: 我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。
texts.en: We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the chains of flesh and gravity.

texts.zh:
完成了。[behemoth_winner.GetName]超越了血肉，超越了帝国，也超越了一切能被称为文明的东西。它不再是个国家，它是力量的本身。

星球在它面前吹弹可破，舰队化为齑粉。坚固的最终避难所像灰烬一样吹散到虚空。没有外交，没有抗辩，没有最后的立场。

我们不是为了生存而战。我们只是在推迟灭亡。末日来了。
texts.en:
It is over. The [behemoth_winner.GetName] has ascended beyond flesh, beyond empire, beyond anything that could be called civilization. It is no longer a nation. It is a force.

Worlds crumble before it. Fleets burn. The final refuges of the once-mighty scatter like embers in the void. There is no diplomacy, no plea, no final stand.

We are not fighting for survival. We are only delaying consumption. The end has come.

texts.zh:
似乎我们的飞升并不会如入无人之境。我们感知到[event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName]星系中那无法估量的存在。那是一只虚空孳孽，一种古老的怪物，其存在甚至超越了凡人野心所构建的最宏伟造物。

它那超乎常理的外形颠覆了传统的认知，将星系笼罩在一片阴沉的暮色之中，仿佛连星辰本身也在畏惧它的经过。

虚空孳孽的意图如同它的轨迹一样清晰——它为我们而来，为噬天巨兽而来，为那个敢于超越肉体、试图掌控虚空的集体意识而来。这并非仅仅是物质力量的对抗，而是对我们所成为之物的考验。

毫无疑问，如果现在冒然出战我们必死无疑。必须暂避锋芒、卧薪尝胆，直到我们的尖牙利齿长到足以洞穿一切为止。
texts.en:
It seems our ascension will not go unchallenged. We sense an incalculable mass in the [event_target:voidspawn_spawn_location.GetName] system. It is a Voidspawn, an ancient monstrosity whose presence dwarfs even the mightiest constructs of mortal ambition.

Its unearthly form defies conventional understanding, casting the galaxy into a grim twilight, as if the stars themselves feared its passage.

The Voidspawn's intent is as clear as its trajectory - it comes for us, our Behemoth body and the collective mind that dared to transcend flesh to claim dominion over the void. This is no mere confrontation of material power; it is a test of what we have become.

There is no doubt that if we were to fight now, we would die. We must evade it for now and keep growing in strength until our fangs grow sharp enough to pierce the unpierceable.

texts.zh:
这是一条至关重要的信息。远古虚空孳孽，一个拥有难以理解力量的实体，已从虚空的深处显现。它被[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]所吸引，这是一个超越生死、与野兽合二为一的帝国。这两大截然对立的巨擘，如今正威胁着整个星系。

若噬天巨兽陨落，虚空孳孽或许会停下肆虐的脚步。若噬天巨兽获胜，它所掌控的力量可能会永远改变整个星系的平衡。做好准备吧，因为此刻的选择将塑造未来的永恒。
texts.en:
This is a message of utmost importance. The Elder Voidspawn, an entity of incomprehensible power, has emerged from the depths of the void. It is drawn to the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], an empire that has transcended mortality and become one with a beast. These two titans, diametrically opposed, now threaten the entire galaxy.

Should the Behemoth fall, the Voidspawn may rest. Should the Behemoth prevail, the power it commands will shift the balance of the galaxy forever. Prepare yourselves, for the choices made now will shape the eons to come.

responses.zh:
你错了。“防范于未然”是那些“未然”的人才配关心的。我们已经没有这样的余裕了。

巨兽已至。我们古老的秩序在过去经受住了灾难，但坦率地说：我们已经到了最危险的时刻。
responses.en:
You misunderstand. Prevention is the concern of those who still have time. We no longer have such luxury.

The beast is here. Our ancient order has withstood calamity in the past, but speaking plainly: the situation in which we now find ourselves is critical.

responses.zh:
一个可以理解的问题。幼稚，但是可以理解。智慧带来接纳。而我们知道没有人会来救我们。

我们的力量太小，能做的太少。你们本可以早点采取行动阻止这一切。如果你们现在没能打败[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，当星系分崩离析的时候，我们也会尽量不去反对你们。
responses.en:
An understandable question. Naive, but understandable. With wisdom comes acceptance. We understand that nobody is coming to save us.

Our order is small so there is little we could have done. You, however, could have acted sooner to stop this. Should you now fail to defeat the [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName], we will try not to hold that against you as the galaxy falls apart.

responses.zh:
帝国往往都有一种追求超出能力范围事物的倾向。特别是[event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName]，选择了野心而非谨慎，傲慢而不明智。

他们拥有自己无法理解的力量，强迫自己的身体变成自己无法控制的形态。在这过程中，他们很可能就注定了我们所有人的命运。
responses.en:
Empires have a tendency to reach beyond their means. The [event_target:behemoth_empire.GetName] in particular chose ambition over caution, and arrogance over wisdom.

They wielded powers beyond their comprehension, forced their bodies into forms they could not control. And in doing so, they have likely doomed us all.

responses.zh:
基于你们战斗能力的初步分析，我们觉得你们参战是不会有好结果的。然而逃跑也是徒劳，目前看来，这种局面无可避免。

两头可怖的巨兽摩拳擦掌要在星间大战一番。如果运气好的话，兴许能苟活下去。

如果明智点，就要从这件蠢事中吸取点教训。但要知道，当这场战争结束时，星系都将被改变。我们中是否有人还在这里看到它完全是另一回事了。

……假设，如果你试图拯救星系，杀死噬天巨兽可能会结束虚空孳孽的狩猎。
responses.en:
Based on initial analysis of your combat capabilities, we do not think fighting would end well for you. Assessments of your fleets indicate fleeing would be similarly futile. The present situation is unavoidable.

Two formidable beasts are squaring up to do battle across the stars. If you are fortunate, you may outlast them.

If you are wise, you will learn from this folly. But know this: when the battle ends, the galaxy will be changed. Whether any of us are still here to see it is another matter entirely.

... Hypothetically, if you were to attempt to save the galaxy, slaying the Behemoth may put an end to the Voidspawn's hunt.

texts.zh:
有一只巨大的虚空孳孽正在星系中横冲直撞。它想要猎杀巨型生物，如果我们替它解决了这些目标，它可能就会放过我们。

目标：寻找并消灭星系中所有四级噬天巨兽。
texts.en:
There's a big voidspawn plowing through the galaxy. It wants to kill big behemoths and presumably, if we kill them for it, it might leave us alone.

OBJECTIVE: Find and Kill all tier 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.

texts.zh:
远古虚空孳孽已然降临我们的领域。这一远古实体据说无人能敌、不死不灭。它的眼中闪烁着玄秘的智慧，它的一举一动都牵动着纪元之重。

我们的[species.GetEyeNamePlural]中只有在重压下破碎的信号。混沌、扭曲以及最深层次的宇宙之怖在脑海深处回荡。

对我们来说，战胜这种野兽是不可想象的，但如果我们能帮助它杀死猎物，我们可能会阻止它的狂暴。找到噬天巨兽并杀死它是我们生存的唯一机会。
texts.en:
An Elder Voidspawn has crossed into our territory. This ancient entity is rumored to be immortal and invincible. Its eyes shimmer with alien intellect, and its movements ripple with the weight of eons.

Our [species.GetEyeNamePlural] are overwhelmed with fragmented signals. Chaos, distortion, and the deepest cosmic fear reverberate within us.

For us to prevail against such a beast is unthinkable, but we may yet halt its rampage if we can help it kill its prey. Finding the Behemoth and slaying it is our only shot at survival.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价躲避怪兽！
label.en: Avoid the monster at all costs!

texts.zh: 最终，远古虚空孳孽的不灭神话终究还是在我们强大舰队的进攻下破灭了。解决了这个古老的威胁后，整个星系又一次沐浴在了自由的风中。
texts.en: In the end, the rumored invincibility of the elder Voidspawn turned out to be yet another myth, dispelled by the might of our fleets. With this ancient threat now dealt with, the galaxy may again breathe easy.

texts.zh:
远古虚空孳孽已逝，其血肉中还跳动着残余的力量。它古老而而强大，对我们来说就是一场滋养潜能的盛宴。

孳孽的筋肉和骨髓将被吞食，它的独特本质将与我们的融合在一起。虚空孳孽的力量很巨大，而现在就是我们的了。
texts.en:
Though the Elder Voidspawn has perished, its body thrums with residual energy. Ancient and potent, to us it is a nourishing banquet of raw potential.

The sinews and marrow of the beast shall be consumed, its alien essence entwined with our own. The Voidspawn's power was immense, and now, it is ours to wield.

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽已不复存在。一个令星辰相形见绌的庞然大物已被消灭。它那不属于这个位面的形态的残骸如今在虚空中漂流，渐渐化为乌有。

另一个帝国展示了我们难以想象的强大火力和协调能力。星海已不再是我们所认知的模样。力量的平衡已然改变，我们在其中的地位也随之动摇。

这些巨兽的猎杀者究竟为何而战？这究竟是一次向所有可能反对他们的人传递信息的力量展示，还是某种更为可怕之事的前奏？
texts.en:
The voidspawn is no more. An enormity that dwarfed the stars has been slain. The wreckage of its otherworldly form now drifts through the void, slowly dissipating into nothingness.

Another empire has demonstrated firepower and coordination beyond our wildest imagining. The galaxy is not as it seemed. The balance of power has shifted, as has our place within it.

What drives them, these slayers of beasts? Was this a show of strength, a message to all who would oppose them, or merely the prelude to something far worse?

texts.zh:
如果这个星系拥有能够摧毁远古虚空孳孽的力量，那么它同样也能摧毁我们。我们与被消灭的巨兽并无太大区别。

那撕裂它古老躯体的火力，终有一日也可能转向我们。星系已经发生了变化，我们必须随之改变以求生存。

我们的生存不能只倚仗盲目的热血了。虚空已经见证了一个顶级掠食者的陨落，也许下一个也只是时间问题。
texts.en:
If this galaxy contains forces capable of destroying the Elder Voidspawn, then it can also destroy us. We are not so different from the beast that was slain.

The same firepower that sundered its ancient flesh could one day be turned against us. The galaxy has shifted, and we must change to meet it.

Our survival will demand more than blind rage. The void has seen one apex predator fall. It may yet see another.

texts.zh:
某种东西在涌动。我们内心的饥饿并非盲目的原生欲望，而是具有某种适应性。新的事物悄然出现，充满潜力的脉动。

在恒星风浪中游弋并穿越虚空，是仅有少数太空物种才所掌握的技能。我们的战术优势在于我们的愤怒与力量，但如果我们的机动性能够提升，又会有怎样一番天地呢？
texts.en:
Something stirs. The hunger within us is not mindless, but adaptive. New growths slither into existence, pulsing with potential.

Swimming the solar waves and traversing the void is a skill possessed by few spacefaring species. Our tactical strengths lie in our fury and our might, but what if our mobility could be improved?

我们的卵是我们血脉延续的根本。我们必须不惜一切代价保护并照料它们。让我们引导进化，以造福未来的幼年体。
texts.en:
Something stirs. The hunger within us is not mindless, but adaptive. New growths slither into existence, pulsing with potential.

Our eggs are the literal lifeblood of our lineage. They must be protected and cared for at all costs. Let us guide our evolution to benefit our future hatchlings.

texts.zh:
随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。

目标：
—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。
—完成生长痛局势
—击杀远古虚空孳孽
texts.en:
With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush any would be contender, whomever they may be.

OBJECTIVES:
- Find and Kill any other class 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.
- Complete the Growing Pains situation.
- Slay the Elder Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 噬天巨兽的最终痛苦无法忍受。有过多的自我存在于这只巨兽当中，它意识的回响逐渐消逝时，我们也一同凋亡。
texts.en: The final agony of the Behemoth proves unbearable. Too much of us is inside of the creature, and as the echoes of its consciousness fade, so do we.

label.zh: 失败：心灵连接的巨兽陨落

note.zh: 四级巨兽被摧毁时，帝国的殖民地与舰船被毁，国家随之覆灭。
note.en: When the Class IV Behemoth is destroyed, the empire's colonies and ships are destroyed and the country is removed.

texts.zh:
在虚空的彼端，一个可怕的启示出现了：我们并非独自飞升。另一只噬天巨兽出现了，这只模仿者膨胀着怪诞的威严，妄图匹敌我们的完美。这是不能容忍的。

一宇不容二兽。没有和平可言，只有血肉的盛宴。狩猎开始了。
texts.en:
Across the void, a dreadful revelation: we are not alone in our ascension. Another Behemoth has emerged, the imitator swollen in grotesque majesty, looking to emulate our perfection. This cannot stand.

There is no room for another apex predator. There is no peace to be made. Only flesh to be devoured. The hunt begins.

label.en: We shall feast on its heart!

texts.zh:
虚空的深处有什么在搅动着。

在繁星彼端，一个帝国开始了怪诞变异的最终阶段，孵育着一只可怖的噬天巨兽，它不仅仅是一件武器而是一个容器。他们不再寻求疆域统治，而是要凝聚为一。将意识和血肉融合，将帝国和恐惧同化。

如果他们成功了，他们将不再是一群人，而是某种单一而巨大的饥饿化身。

这是绝不可容忍的。如果想要阻止他们，那就只能是现在，赶在他们跨过最终阈值之前。
texts.en:
Something stirs in the depths of the void.

Across the stars, an empire has begun the final stage of its grotesque transformation, breeding monstrous Behemoths, not as mere weapons, but as vessels. They do not seek dominion. They seek union. A merging of mind and flesh, of empire and horror.

If they succeed, they will cease to be a people and instead become a singular, vast hunger.

This cannot be allowed. If they are to be stopped, it must be done now, before the final threshold is crossed.

texts.zh: 从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。
texts.en: Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further biological enhancements.

texts.zh: 我们已经开发了几种诱变配方来增强我们的噬天巨兽，每一种都是量身定制的，可以解锁新的力量和适应性。然而，它庞杂的生理机能只能承受一次注射——任何结合多种配方的尝试都会导致灾难性的细胞衰竭。进化和毁灭之间的界限很薄，我们必须明智地选择强化的方式。
texts.en: We have developed several mutagenic formulas designed to enhance our Behemoths, each tailored to unlock new strengths and adaptations. However, their immense physiology can only withstand a single injection - any attempt to combine multiple formulas results in catastrophic cellular failure. The line between evolution and annihilation is razor-thin, and we must choose our enhancements wisely.

label.en: The power of the Shroud will sustain them.

texts.zh: 我们的一头巨兽陨落了。这就是弱者的命运；自然会将它们淘汰。虽然我们不会为一头无法在战斗中自保的噬天巨兽哀悼，但我们最好将精力集中在确保它的同类不会遭遇相同的命运上。我们必须确保我们后裔的长存，否则我们也将陨落。
texts.en: One of our beasts has fallen. This is what happens to weak creatures; nature disposes of them. Although we do not mourn a Behemoth who could not prevail in battle, we would do well to focus our efforts on ensuring its siblings do not meet the same fate. We must ensure the longevity of our spawn, else we too will fall.

label.en: This death will not be in vain.

texts.zh:
噬天巨兽死了。

它硕大无朋的躯体静静地飘在虚空中，有如一座纪念碑，诉说着我们的胜利，也记录着理解的边际。[Root.GetScientistPluralCapital]争先恐后地分析它的残骸，渴望从它那不可思议的心灵中攫取秘密。然而，每一次复活的尝试——无论是机器、死灵术，或是最绝望的祈祷——都失败了。

原因现在已经非常清楚了：巨兽的大脑不仅仅是一个细胞网络，而是一个有机超导体晶格，以任何已知智能——人工智能、生物智能或奥术智能——都无法复制的方式交织在一起。它死后，神经结构如同破损得无法修复的电路一样崩溃。没有能量，没有意志，没有力量可以重新组装这种逝去之物。

星系中最具力量的意识现在、永远陷入了沉默。
texts.en:
The Behemoth is dead.

Its titanic form drifts lifelessly in the void, a monument to both our triumph and the limits of comprehension. [Root.GetScientistPluralCapital] scrambled to analyze its remains, eager to plunder the secrets of its impossible mind. Yet every attempt to revive it - by machine, necromancy, or even the most desperate invocations failed.

The reason has now become painfully clear: The Behemoth's brain was not merely a network of cells but a lattice of organic superconductors, interwoven in ways no known intelligence - artificial, biological, or arcane - can replicate. In death, its neural structure collapsed like a circuit shattered beyond repair. No energy, no will, no force can reassemble what has been lost.

The greatest mind in the galaxy is now, and forever, silent.

texts.zh:
尽管面临挑战，我们仍然孕育出了一头新的噬天巨兽，它破茧而出。

这是一头更为巨大凶猛而饥饿的噬天巨兽。这头生物现在正饥渴地在虚空中游荡，寻找养分。

这头巨兽是兽群的骄傲，将给所有胆敢挡路的人带来难以想象的毁灭。
texts.en:
Despite the challenges, we have birthed a Behemoth which now springs forth from the chrysalis where it was incubated.

Larger, fiercer and hungrier. The creature now prowls the void in search of sustenance.

This beast is the pride of the pack, and will bring untold destruction upon all who dare to cross its path.

label.zh: 我们再次超越了自然的极限。
label.en: We exceed nature's limits once more.

# 巨兽之怒 / Behemoth Fury

- 分类 Category：天灾（玩家天灾路线）Crisis (player crisis path) · DLC: 生物起源 BioGenesis

## 如何开始 How it starts

选择“巨兽之怒”飞升天赋后进入该天灾路线；第一级开启“巨兽天灾”事件链，3天后收到“第一级：胚胎实验”（biocrisis.50）。天灾货币为“野性洞见”。
Choosing the "Behemoth Fury" ascension perk enters this crisis path; level 1 opens the "Behemoth Crisis" event chain, and 3 days later "Level 1: Embryo Experiment" (biocrisis.50) arrives. The crisis currency is "Wild Insight".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **五个等级**：二级要求建成巨兽之卵（2000）；三级要求巨兽孵化（6000），开启项目“脑联试验”→“突触交响”；四级要求该项目完成（18000），开启“心灵融合”项目（→“与兽合一”）与变异项目（→ 280 选择变异）；五级要求项目四完成、45000、非附庸。
   **Five levels**: level 2 requires a completed Behemoth Egg (2000); level 3 requires a Behemoth hatching (6000), opening the project "Mind-Link Trial" -> "Synaptic Symphony"; level 4 requires that project completed (18000), opening the "Psychic Fusion" project (-> "One with the Beast") and a mutation project (-> 280, choose a mutation); level 5 requires project four completed, 45000, and not being a vassal.
2. **成长期支线**：首次在茧中孵出巨兽（130）；孵出的巨兽若被非巨兽帝国击瘫会死去，你获得洞见（105；击杀者若为复生者帝国则见 520）。
   **Growth-phase side branch**: the first Behemoth hatched in a cocoon (130); if a hatched Behemoth is crippled by a non-Behemoth empire it dies and you gain insight (105; if the killer is a Resurrected empire, see 520).
3. **第五级**：共同体被迫宣告你为星系危机（星海天罚档案 4105）；其他五级巨兽帝国与其余帝国分别收到 185/187。选择开启局势“成长之痛”：各阶段选择变异（210–245）；第二阶段召来虚空之子（150；若有策展人，非巨兽玩家收到其警告 155；它闯入未获警告者领土时另有 162）；击杀虚空之子者得到遗珍（180），其他人收到 175。局势完成得到“直接控制”（250）。
   **Level 5**: the Community is forced to declare you a galactic crisis (Stellar Retribution archive 4105); other level-5 Behemoth empires and the remaining empires receive 185/187 respectively. Choosing to open the situation "Growing Pains": each stage offers a mutation choice (210–245); the second stage summons a Void Spawn (150; if a Curator exists, non-Behemoth players receive its warning, 155; if it breaks into the territory of those who received no warning, 162 also applies); whoever kills the Void Spawn gets a relic (180), and others receive 175. Completing the situation grants "Direct Control" (250).
4. **结局**：当没有其他五级巨兽帝国、虚空之子也已不在时，年度检查给出“顶点虚空形态”（190）：立即完成转化（30天后）或先进行转化项目，均到“巨兽胜利”（191）——留下肆虐、离开银河，或在得知“猎手”后前去对抗（其他玩家720天后收到“吞噬殆尽”196 → 项目 → 197）。其他玩家在 190 后1天收到警告（192）。
   **Ending**: when no other level-5 Behemoth empire exists and the Void Spawn is also gone, the annual check gives "Apex Void Form" (190): either complete the transformation immediately (30 days later) or run the transformation project first; both lead to "Behemoth Victory" (191) — either leave the galaxy ravaged and depart, or, after learning of the "Hunter", go to confront it (other players receive "Consumed Entirely" 196 after 720 days -> project -> 197). Other players receive a warning (192) one day after 190.
5. **失败**：心灵连接的四级巨兽被摧毁，帝国随之覆灭（265）。
   **Failure**: if the level-4 Behemoth in the psychic link is destroyed, the empire falls with it (265).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 胜利：191（`win = yes`）；失败：265。
  Victory: 191 (`win = yes`); failure: 265.
- 互斥：185/187（收件方是否也是五级巨兽）；180/175（击杀者与其他人）。
  Mutually exclusive: 185/187 (whether the recipient is also a level-5 Behemoth); 180/175 (the killer versus everyone else).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 191 的“前去对抗”选项需要先在索林原虫天灾中通过外交得知“猎手”（learned_about_redacted）。
  The "go confront it" option in 191 requires first learning of the "Hunter" through diplomacy in the Prethoryn crisis (learned_about_redacted).
- 第五级天赋“心灵融合”反过来让该帝国能读懂索林原虫的讯息（can_talk_to_prethoryn）。
  Conversely, the level-5 perk "Psychic Fusion" lets the empire read Prethoryn messages (can_talk_to_prethoryn).
- 197 的回应按宇宙创生天赋或索林原虫虫后遗珍变化。
  The response in 197 varies with the Cosmogenesis perk or the Prethoryn Queen relic.
